design_rules: Board is PCB-02: the 24 x 8 mm DRV5033 Hall daughterboard for the independent tach (grown from the spec's 18 x 8 on 2026-07-30 with owner sign-off: side-entry JST courtyard + two M2 holes need the length). 2-layer FR-4 1.6 mm, 1 oz copper, JLCPCB standard process. Do not change the outline without asking.

Three components only: U1 DRV5033FAQDBZR (SOT-23 DBZ), C1 100 nF 0603 bypass close to U1, J1 S3B-PH-K-S side-entry JST-PH 3-pin. There is NO pull-up on this board - the open-drain output's 10 kOhm pull-up is R43 on PCB-01.
J1 pinout mirrors J3 on PCB-01: pin 1 = 3V3, pin 2 = HALL_TACH, pin 3 = AGND. Side entry: cable exits in the board plane, away from the hub, off the outer (x=24) edge.

Two 2.2 mm NPTH mounting holes (H1, H2) at board-local (7,4) and (14,4) - absolute (57,54)/(64,54), board origin (50,50). They are the BR-100 bracket datum: do not move them without asking. All components on the magnet-facing side; U1 at the inner (x=0) end on the r76 line.
The DRV5033 sensing face points at the rotor magnet (sensing axis perpendicular to the board); the sensor element position on the board drives the BR-100 bracket design, which is not yet drawn.
This board is hand-assembled from parts in hand (DRV5033 x3, 100 nF strip); it ships as its own small JLCPCB order. Record MPN and LCSC fields anyway.
Part of the analog overspeed safety chain (DRV5033 -> LM2907 -> TLV1701 -> U6 latch): must work with no firmware participation.
